questions: B0:B9BE carries the Star Wars label BSHEM2 in the middle of the lower half of the big disc outline. in Star Wars BSHEM2 is the second half of the circle that BSHEM jumps to. the ESB list that the first list of set 0 jumps to is at B0:BA2C ($28B0), which i named s0_big_top, so i listed B9BE under sw_drop_names. the format describes sw_drop_names for routines, please check that it also works on a data label

set 0 $2800 (s0_big_half) and $2808 (s0_big_disc), the big striped disc: no JSRL to $2808 exists in any ROM, and the callers of JSRL $2800 that are reached (vew_walker_end, vew_wave_bonus) run with set 1 or 2 loaded, where $2800 is the rebel hideout or Darth Vader's helmet. the big disc looks like a leftover of Star Wars' detailed Death Star (BSHEM, BSCIR) turned into a planet
vew_die_plain (phase $3E, which the earlier notes found nothing enters) also draws JSRL $2800: which picture that would be depends on the set loaded at the time
set 2 $2C12 (s2_x_burst, B0:C486): no JSRL or JMPL to it found in any ROM
V:3340 (VGLZD) has no caller in ESB

the seven-piece picture of vw_shrink_pic (V:34A2-36A9): its two top pieces are the window frames of the type 1 cockpit in colour 1 and it starts where the cockpit is drawn, so it is the player's craft of the TIE fighter and asteroid parts seen from outside as it draws away towards the Executor. that it is the Millennium Falcon is not shown by the data, and i could not tell what the six-sided panel (V:3602) and the detail on the left (V:3646) stand for
s2_vader (B0:C074) is identified by its shape only: a dome, two eye pieces, a triangular mouth grille with six bars in colour 5 and a flared base. no message names it

the listing splits a VCTR in two where a label was made from a number that is not an address of this data, and then shows the x word as a jump or centre instruction. the real instructions are: B0:BA7A VCTR 2944,0,7 - B0:BAA6 VCTR 160,144,0 and B0:BAAA VCTR 1280,0,7 - B0:BAC6 VCTR 1,-15,7 - B0:BAEA VCTR 6,15,7 - B0:BAFE VCTR -6,15,7 - B0:BB22 VCTR -1,-15,7 - B0:BDEA VCTR -10,37,0 and B0:BDEE VCTR 0,-10,4 - B0:BDF2 VCTR 15,38,0 and B0:BDF6 VCTR 0,15,4 - B0:BEBA VCTR 87,-75,4 - B0:BEDC VCTR 75,0,7 - B0:BF7A VCTR -5,-15,5 - B0:BF88 VCTR 0,134,7 - V:3C8A VCTR 15,0,7. the labels LBA7C, LBAA7/LBAA8, LBAC8/LBAC9, LBAEB/LBAEC, LBB00/LBB01, LBB23/LBB24 come from the JSRL words of vw_shrink_pic ($BA7C, $BAA7, $BAC9, $BAEB, $BB01, $BB23), not from references to these addresses

regions: i marked the tables B0:B92C-B92F and B0:B938-B973 as avg words although they lie just before my range, because they are the JMPL and JSRL words to these pictures and the listing shows them as .byte. LB943 and LB959 inside them are labels made from the JSRL constants $B943 (JSRL VGINIT) and $B959 (JSRL VGFCWN), not real addresses. i also named the tables there (VTGNB, VTGNX, VTGNT are Star Wars' tables of that name, which the matcher missed, the rest are new)

the vector RAM slot aliases carried from Star Wars no longer say what the slots hold: in ESB $001A has the shot picture (Star Wars VRGNB), $001C the tip fuse (VRGNT), $001E the shot explosion (VRGNX), while $0020 (alias VRLZS) has the sparkle, $0022 (alias VRGNX) the ring of sparkles and $0024 (alias VRGNT) the triangle of the asteroid flash
VGLZS3 (V:3390) keeps its Star Wars name but its vectors are not Star Wars' (an eight-sided outline 28 wide and 42 high). its carried comments were not checked
some first lines already carry an Atari macro comment (V:36AA COLOR VGCRED, V:3EDA, V:3EF6, V:3F26 and others). i gave them a comment anyway since the task asked for one on every list
